propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, making it vulnerable to transient object-db read failures that other store paths ride out via run_git_write
fatal: bad object HEAD in three CI runs is a proven transient missing-object condition, reproduced byte-for-byte when the merge commit's loose object is deleted before the bundle call
s3_doctor must route through gitutil.run_git_write to inherit the per-store advisory git-op lock and bounded transient-marker retry, eliminating the structural gap
the existing transient-marker family must gain the proven missing-object signature (bad object) so identical retry attempts self-heal without new retry logic or backoff policy
S3DoctorConflict error hint must distinguish object-db read failure from heads conflict, since git bundle create mutates no store state and satisfies transient-retry idempotency preconditions
